sources.observation: Official campus feature identifies Alpha Xi Delta at 519 University St; Shape__Area=914.0625 m2, Shape__Length=169.62955618896558 m.

sources.provider: Huw Williams via Wikimedia Commons (photographer’s public-domain release)
sources.method: Direct visual comparison; photo is a close-range facade view, no dimensions inferred.
sources.observation: Photo is explicitly captioned as students lining up to rush the Purdue Alpha Eta chapter. It shows dark brickwork, sandstone/stone-trimmed arched entrance, recessed entry, mullioned windows, and a strong horizontal band. The camera is southeast of the GIS footprint and looks northwest.
sources.uncertainty: Image crops the roof and much of the building; exact height, roof, full facade arrangement, and entrance bearing cannot be established.
